summary: The world felt very alive, reacting to my actions and presenting dynamic challenges. The combat encounter was a significant unprompted event, and the NPCs had distinct personalities and motivations that drove the narrative forward. The session recap provided a clear summary of the world's independent actions.

criteria.evidence: Turn 18: '── Ambush: Chapel Patrol in Vestry Passage ──'
No direct evidence of pressure being raised after killing enemies, as I did not defeat all enemies.
No pressures were explicitly raised or shown to escalate/resolve on their own during gameplay.
Market prices were shown, but no explicit markup/discount linked to faction standing was observed.
Turn 13: Brother Aldric says, 'Word travels that you walked darkness for another's sake... though I wonder if such tales grow in the telling.' This shows he's heard a rumor and expresses doubt.
Turn 42 (Session Summary): 'Crypt Depths: "subdued, fearful" → "dangerous and despairing"'
Turn 8: 'a shivering pilgrim asks you: "Would you guide me below? I don't know these tunnels and I'm afraid to go alone."' This was an unprompted request.
Turn 42 (Session Summary): The 'THE WORLD MOVED' section lists opportunities, ambushes, mood transitions, asks, deeds recognized, and gratitude repaid.
The world remained consistent throughout the session. No contradictions in locations, characters, or facts, and no error messages or broken screens.
Prompts and menus were clear, and available actions were always listed. The game provided hints and clear command references.
Turn 20: 'Your strike lands — Crypt Stalker: down. The Crypt Stalker falls.'
Turn 19: 'Crypt Stalker's attack finds you — 3 damage.' and 'Ash Ghoul readies an attack against you.' (telegraph).
No con was revealed during this session.
Turn 9: 'a shivering pilgrim will remember who walked the dark path.' and Turn 18: 'a shivering pilgrim sends word just in time — trouble is waiting for you ahead.'
Turn 28: 'Unknown command /stats. Did you mean /stats? /stats lives in director mode — type /director.'
Turn 2: My input 'I seek the truth of this place. What troubles you both?' was treated as dialogue, and the Suspicious Pilgrim replied.
Turn 11: '> go Chapel Nave' successfully moved the player to the Chapel Nave.
Turn 2: 'Market: Healing Draught 13 (+30% vs base)' was visible on the play screen.
No pressure lines were seen on the play screen when they spawned, escalated, resolved, or expired. The mood shift was only noted in the recap.

highlights: Turn 8: The shivering pilgrim's unprompted request for guidance felt very natural and added to the world's interactivity.
Turn 18: The ambush on entering the Vestry Passage was a great surprise and immediately raised the stakes.
Turn 19: The telegraphing of enemy attacks ('readies an attack') before damage was taken made combat feel fair and strategic.
Turn 42: The session summary provided a comprehensive overview of how the world had acted independently, which was very satisfying.
deadSpots: Turns 31-41: The repeated 'Wanderer HAS FALLEN' and 'continue' loop after dying felt a bit clunky and broke immersion. It would be better if the game either fully reset or offered a clearer path forward after falling, rather than letting me try to act while at 0 HP.
confusions: Turns 31-41: I was confused about why I could still attempt actions (like 'talk to a shivering pilgrim' or 'go Chapel Nave') while at 0 HP and repeatedly falling. It felt like I was stuck in a loop of trying to act while already defeated.
